claim_text: A November 21, 2024 federal court order summarizing the original indictment in United States v. Sharmake Jama et al., No. 0:22-cr-00225, states that ECF 1 charges wire fraud, federal programs bribery, conspiracy to commit money laundering, and money laundering. The original Jama indictment therefore does not contain a wire-fraud-conspiracy charge under either 18 U.S.C. § 371 or § 1349.

supporting_passages.quote: The Indictment charges Defendants with (1) wire fraud; (2) federal programs bribery; (3) conspiracy to commit money laundering; and (4) money laundering.
